source.title: Forebears Botswana forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized names. Gender buckets follow Forebears gender-majority data for high-frequency forenames and are not an official civil registry sample; surnames were cross-filled from the public Botswana surname table.

source.title: ITU Botswana national numbering plan communication of 27.III.2025

phones.notes: ITU/BOCRA confirms country code +267 and eight-digit active mobile allocations. This dataset deliberately uses only fully active 71-77 ranges and the confirmed 780-787 slices; active 79 sub-blocks are omitted until represented with finer-grained prefixes, and unlisted 81-85 plan space is not generated.

source.title: Botswana Ministry of Local Government local authorities contacts

locations.notes: Official local authority contacts confirm city/district names used here. UPU address guidance shows Botswana uses P.O. Box and Private Bag style addressing; public sources reviewed do not provide national postcodes, so postalPrefixes are synthetic internal area markers for generator consistency rather than real postal codes.

omang.label: National Identity Card (Omang)

source.title: Botswana Examination Council registration form Omang input rule

omang.notes: Government services confirm Omang is the national identity document; a public Botswana Examination Council registration form validates Omang as nine numeric digits. No official checksum, semantic digit rule or live registry validation was found, so generation is a simple synthetic nine-digit value.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Botswana ordinary passport document entry

passport.notes: PRADO confirms Botswana ordinary, diplomatic and official passport document families. The public PRADO category page reviewed does not confirm the visible passport number grammar; this template remains a synthetic placeholder until an official rule or multiple public samples are available.
